title: [Sopʻaerok]

title: 韓非子 (Hán Fēizǐ), Vol. 1
shelf_note: 韓非子新釋 上卷: a Japanese kanbun edition with modern Japanese rendering and glossary, as catalogued.
rights_flag: Published 1931 (韓非子新釋, 上卷): a 20th-century typeset Japanese annotated translation; the translator/editor is not named on this page, so its copyright status depends on the editor's death date.
structure_note: printed_backsteps 571 of 607 numbered pages is almost certainly the kanji page numerals (二七〇) being parsed badly, not a real disorder; this page's 二七〇 sits correctly at leaf 343.

ocr_errors.ocr: 吾恐此將令其宗廟不血食也
ocr_errors.image: 吾恐此將令其宗廟不祓除而社稷不血食也
ocr_errors.problem: the clause 不祓除而社稷 is dropped

tr_errors.source: 獻公不幸離羣臣。出入十年矣。
tr_errors.english: Duke Xian unfortunately left his ministers. It has been ten years of people leaving and entering.
tr_errors.problem: 離羣臣 is the euphemism for dying, and 出入十年 refers to ten years of turmoil/exile; the English is literal and misleading

tr_errors.english: None of the lords have not heard of it.

other.note: the OCR's <vocab> list is rendered as a '<margin> Vocabulary' block in the English, which the page does not have

book_verdict: A clean read of a 1931 Japanese Han Feizi edition; the kanbun loses one clause and the English renders Duke Xian's death literally. Rights should be checked (1931 annotated edition).

title: 真誥 (卷九~卷十二): Zhen'gao, vol.3
shelf_note: display_title is 'Disputations on Nature and Theology', a Latin scholastic title, while title, author and this cover (四庫全書 子部) point to Tao Hongjing's Zhen'gao; either the catalogue or the scan is wrong. Not verified beyond this page.
structure_note: Only 1 of 181 pages translated (this cover). The translation's meta claims that the following pages contain Latin scholastic philosophy, which, with the display_title, suggests a catalogue or scan mix-up (I7).

other.note: the reader-facing display_title is 'Disputations on Nature and Theology' on a Siku Quanshu copy of Tao Hongjing's Zhen'gao

the English carries a <meta>: 'The source title attributes this to Tao Hongjing, but the following pages contain Latin scholastic philosophy. This page serves as a formal Chinese imperial library cover.' (model commentary about other pages, unverified here)

book_verdict: The cover is read correctly, but the book is displayed as 'Disputations on Nature and Theology' and the stored English says the following pages are Latin scholastic philosophy. The catalogue identity has to be checked before this is shown.

title: Chʻŏnha yŏjido
shelf_note: Korean atlas cover, title slip 天下輿地圖.

ocr_errors.ocr: 方輿徐覽下卷
ocr_errors.image: 玄黓執徐臘下澣 (a cyclical date: renchen year, 12th month, last decade — matching the catalogue's 'published: 玄黓執徐')
ocr_errors.problem: a date inscription read as a work title

tr_errors.english: Comprehensive Survey of Geography, Volume Two … the second or "lower" volume of a larger geographical work titled "Fangyu xulan."
tr_errors.problem: a non-existent work 'Fangyu xulan' is presented to the reader as this book's larger title; the inscription is a date

book_verdict: The title slip is right, but the cover's date inscription (玄黓執徐臘下澣) is turned into an invented work title, 'Fangyu xulan, lower volume'. The English then builds a false bibliography on it.

structure_note: The leaf is an unsplit two-page opening, which is fine for this manuscript.

title: Sinpʻyŏn Kimyo yujŏk, v. 1, 4-kwŏn
shelf_note: Records of the Kimyo (1519) scholars, Classical Chinese, as catalogued.

ocr_errors.ocr: 近來不應科者為有獎習
ocr_errors.image: 近来不應科者為有弊習
ocr_errors.problem: 弊 (bad habit) read 獎 (encourage): reverses the sense, which is carried into the English

ocr_errors.ocr: …亦何益於國家哉
ocr_errors.image: …亦何益於國家哉士
ocr_errors.problem: the column's last character 士 (running into the next page) is dropped

tr_errors.source: 近來不應科者為有獎習朝廷及泮宮皆有此意
tr_errors.english: Recently, those who do not respond to the regular examinations do so because they have been encouraged by the court and the National Academy
tr_errors.problem: the source (弊習) says shunning the examinations has become a bad habit, and that court and academy share this attitude; the English makes the court encourage it

tr_errors.english: many in the central government do not act with sincerity
tr_errors.problem: 中朝 here is more likely the Ming court (China), not 'central government'

book_verdict: A clean transcription and fluent English. One misread (獎 for 弊) turns a complaint about bad habits into a claim that the court encourages shunning the exams.
